patch_description: Two targeted improvements. (1) Fully vectorize the smallest-triangle computation using a precomputed combination index matrix, so each score evaluation is a single vectorized cross-product computation over all 286 triples instead of a Python loop; this roughly cuts scoring cost several-fold and lets the optimizer do many more descent steps within the same time budget. (2) Replace the single seed (12-gon + center, which is limited by center-point triples) with a deterministic multi-start strategy over several structured, symmetry-informed seeds (regular 13-gon, 12-gon+center, perturbed circle, 3-fold symmetric ring configuration), refining each by coordinate descent and returning the best-scoring configuration. Multi-start mitigates the poor local optimum of a single seed while keeping determinism (no RNG, or fixed-seed perturbations). Empirically, boundary-heavy configurations such as near-regular 13-gons give much larger minimum triangle areas for n=13 than configurations with interior points, so seeding with boundary-focused candidates directly targets the score.
